paragraphs: Rabbi Abba bar Mina, in Rav’s name (Jerusalem Talmud, printed here ר״ע הזהב); beginning of chapter Eizehu Neshekh: Rabbi Ba bar Mina. He asked Rav (first chapter of Bava Metzia); and Rabbi Yosa in Rabbi Yochanan’s name (there, beginning of the first chapter of Bava Metzia, halakhah 5). Perhaps he is Rabbi Abba bar Avina or bar Bina mentioned above, since the Jerusalem Talmud habitually omits or substitutes a letter.
